systems.name: terrain
systems.summary: Draws the marching cubes chunks: earth, soil patches, rock, relief, darkened under the grass.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: Ground anisotropy; terrain, grass, grass_pass, grass_params.height, scree, relief.

access.name: Settings
access.effect: ground_relief scales the relief depths.

access.name: Executor
access.effect: tf::Executor that decodes the ground textures (a local one when absent).

access.name: TerrainBuffers
access.effect: Vertex buffer of each slot and the indirect draw buffer.

access.name: SoilLayers
access.effect: Layer of the soil map of each chunk, pushed per draw.

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: Chunk origin for the soil map lookup.

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: Slot of the chunk's mesh.

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: Only chunks whose mesh is drawable are drawn.

side_effects: Reads resources/textures/grass.png, rock.jpg and resources/ground/ground.json with its textures, uploads them as texture arrays.
Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/ground_relief_{mud,stones,sand}.bin and uploads the relief rays.
Decodes the ground textures as taskflow tasks and waits for them in the constructor.
Logs a warning without ground textures, an info line per relief baked.
Records one indirect draw per ready chunk into each target's command buffer.

systems.name: grass
systems.summary: Draws the grass shell over the chunks, looking the view rays up in rays baked against tiles of plants.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: Sets grass_pass = true (constructor); reads grass_anisotropy, grass and grass_params.

access.name: Settings
access.effect: grass_kind: one kind of plant everywhere.

access.name: TerrainBuffers
access.effect: Slot count, vertex buffers, indirect draws.

access.name: SoilLayers
access.effect: Soil map layer of each chunk (no grass on the patches).

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: Chunk position for its height map; origin for the draw.

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: Slot of the chunk's mesh.

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: Drawable chunks get a height map and a draw.

side_effects: Reads, or bakes and writes, ./resources/grass_raycast_<kind>.bin for the ten kinds of plants; uploads the ray textures (about 250 MB, less in blocks).
Uploads the species noise, a tile noise and the height map array.
Queues height map image updates for new chunks and up to 16 rebakes a frame after a parameter change.
Logs bake times and sizes; warns on an unknown grass_kind or an unwritable file.
Records up to three draws of each chunk's shell per target (stencil see through).

systems.name: vegetation
systems.summary: Draws the Plant entities with the SpeedTree library, levels of detail, far plants from their baked volumes; gives species to the rays.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Species and forced level of each plant.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Position, scale and matrix of each plant.

access.name: VegetationStats
access.effect: Plants, drawn, triangles, species loaded and loading.

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Species list and files; loaded and emplaced when absent.

access.name: VegetationPreload
access.effect: Species to load before any plant uses them.

access.name: RayMeshes
access.effect: Adds each species' traced mesh and its leaf textures (ray tracing).

access.name: RayPlantMeshes
access.effect: Emplaced with ray tracing; mesh index and bounds of each loaded species.

access.name: PlantVolumeSet
access.effect: Which species have a baked volume, and its bounds and index.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: vegetation, vegetation_params (lod_bias, force_lod, cull, normal_maps, subsurface), far_plants_on_screen, anisotropy.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Desktop eye for levels of detail and culling.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: Headset session and head position.

access.name: VRRig
access.effect: Rig transform of the headset eye.

access.name: Executor
access.effect: tf::Executor that loads species on workers.

side_effects: Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers (silent_async, 6 at a time); uploads buffers and textures, allocates descriptor sets.
Logs each species loaded, errors for species and textures that fail.
With ray tracing gives meshes and textures to the rays (RayMeshes).
Records the plant draws and the far volume boxes of both targets; the destructor waits for running jobs.

systems.name: animals
systems.summary: Draws the skinned animals of the library; with ray tracing skins the nearest ones for the rays (RayAnimals).

access.name: Animal
access.effect: Species of each animal.

access.name: AnimalPose
access.effect: skin matrices copied into the frame's joint buffer.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Position, rotation, scale and matrix.

access.name: AnimalStats
access.effect: Animals, drawn, triangles, joints, species loaded and loading.

access.name: AnimalLibrary
access.effect: Species definitions and directory; loaded and emplaced when absent.

access.name: RayAnimals
access.effect: Emplaced with ray tracing; cleared and filled every frame with the skinned shadow casters; erased.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: animals, vegetation_params (lod_bias, force_lod, cull, normal_maps), lighting[target].traced_range and animals, anisotropy.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Desktop eye.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: Headset session and head position.

access.name: VRRig
access.effect: Rig transform.

access.name: Executor
access.effect: tf::Executor that loads species on workers.

side_effects: Loads species geometry and textures on taskflow workers; uploads buffers and textures.
Writes the skinning matrices of the frame into a mapped storage buffer per frame in flight.
With ray tracing records animal_skin.rt.comp.glsl dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
Logs species loaded and failures, and a warning past 65536 joints in view.

systems.name: model
systems.summary: Draws the glTF models (Transform + ModelRenderable); gives their meshes to the rays.

access.name: ModelC
access.effect: Material sets and ray_mesh written in update; buffers, parts and materials read in record.

access.name: ModelRenderable
access.effect: Model entity and tint.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Model matrix.

access.name: RayMeshes
access.effect: Adds each model's mesh to the rays (ray tracing).

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: models: false draws nothing.

side_effects: Allocates a descriptor set per material and an image view per texture.
Records the indexed draws of every model part into both targets.

systems.name: ui
systems.summary: Dear ImGui on the desktop window, an overlay drawn after the scene.
side_effects: Creates the ImGui context when absent and uploads its font atlas.
Calls ImGui::Render() every frame and copies the draw lists into mapped buffers.
Records the UI draws into the desktop command buffer.

systems.name: sky
systems.summary: The sky, sun, moon and stars: one fullscreen triangle, always the first pass.
side_effects: Records one fullscreen triangle per target and eye; reads the lights buffer through the view set.

systems.name: RayScene
systems.summary: Acceleration structures of chunks, meshes, animals and the top level every frame, with the geometry table (ray tracing).

access.name: ChunkLit
access.effect: Added when a chunk is in the rays, removed when it lost ChunkTriangles; cleared at the end.

access.name: ChunkTriangles
access.effect: Triangle count and slot of the chunk's mesh; its destruction frees the structure.

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: Distance to the camera for the build order.

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: Slot must be the one that was counted.

access.name: ChunkDestroying
access.effect: Excluded from builds and from pending.

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: Counts chunks pending.

access.name: TerrainBuffers
access.effect: Vertex buffers the chunk structures are built from.

access.name: LightingStats
access.where: constructor, queueBuild, updateChunks, updateMeshes, gatherInstances, buildTop
access.effect: structure_bytes, chunks_lit, chunks_pending, structures_pending, plants_near, plants_far, instances.

access.name: RayMeshes
access.effect: Emplaced and erased here; meshes, boxes and textures read once the passes added them.

access.name: RayBake
access.effect: Places the bake mesh in the scene and sets placed.

access.name: RayAnimals
access.effect: Animals skinned this frame: built or refitted.

access.name: RayPlantMeshes
access.effect: Mesh and volume box of each species.

access.name: PlantInRays
access.effect: Plants within the plant geometry range (with a margin to leave).

access.name: PlantRayTransforms
access.effect: Instance rows of a plant's mesh and box, worked out once.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Species of each plant.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Positions and matrices of plants and models.

access.name: ModelRenderable
access.effect: Model entity of each instance.

access.name: ModelC
access.effect: ray_mesh of the model.

access.name: RigidBody
access.effect: motion: models that move are dynamic instances.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Build order of the chunks; a viewer.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: Headset session and head position.

access.name: VRRig
access.effect: Rig transform.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: streaming.ray_chunks, lighting[t].plant_geometry_range, far_plants_in_rays.

side_effects: Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.

systems.name: ProbeVolume

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: Chunk position, centre and origin.

access.name: ChunkVolume
access.effect: Densities the probes are classified from.

access.name: ChunkLit
access.effect: Only chunks in the rays get a brick.

access.name: ChunkDestroying
access.effect: Going chunks lose their brick.

access.name: Plant
access.effect: Plants around a new brick: the air near them is traced.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Plant positions; torch positions.

access.name: PointLight
access.effect: Torches: probes within their radius are traced every frame.

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Species height and radius.

access.name: LightingStats
access.effect: bricks, probes_pending, probes_active.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: rays_per_probe, probe_rays_per_frame, tree_shade.

access.name: Camera
access.effect: Viewer.

access.name: VRInput
access.effect: Headset session and head position.

access.name: VRRig
access.effect: Rig transform.

side_effects: Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.

systems.name: PlantVolumes
systems.summary: Bakes a density, colour and normal volume per plant species against the rays (ray tracing).

access.name: PlantVolumeSet
access.effect: The baked volume of each species, for the vegetation pass.

access.name: RayPlantMeshes
access.effect: Species meshes and bounds read; box of the volume written.

access.name: RayMeshes
access.effect: Parts of the species' mesh read; the volume's RayBox added.

access.name: RayBake
access.effect: Asks for the baking species in the scene; reads placed.

access.name: LightingStats
access.effect: structures_pending += species still to bake.

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: streaming.plant_volume_slices.

access.name: VegetationLibrary
access.effect: Species id for the log.

side_effects: Allocates three 3D images per baked species; records bake dispatches and mip blits into the frame's compute command buffer.
Writes Context::plant_volumes (view set bindings 10 to 12).
Logs an info line per volume baked.

systems.name: SunVisibility
systems.summary: Per target scene render pass with the sun apart, the traced and filtered sun visibility, the composite (ray tracing).
side_effects: Creates the scene and visibility render passes, images, framebuffers and pipelines of its target.
Records the scene pass, the sun trace and resolve and the composite into the target's command buffer every frame.
Keeps a registry reference but reads nothing from it.

access.effect: Torches: colour, intensity, radius.

access.name: Transform
access.effect: Torch positions.

access.effect: Viewer.

components.name: ChunkLit
components.summary: A chunk whose acceleration structure is in the scene the rays see (or that has no triangle).
components.notes: Added by RayScene::updateChunks once the chunk's bottom level structure is queued (at once when it has no triangle); removed when the chunk loses ChunkTriangles (meshed again); the storage is cleared when RayScene is destroyed. ProbeVolume gives bricks only to ChunkLit chunks. Ray tracing only.

components.name: RayMeshes
components.summary: The meshes, volume boxes and textures the passes give to the rays (ray tracing only).

fields.name: meshes
fields.desc: Meshes to trace: kind (Terrain, Solid, Plant, Volume), vertex and index buffers, vertex stride, first vertex, vertex count, parts (first index, index count, opaque, texture, alpha cutoff, colour, transmission).

fields.name: boxes
fields.desc: Boxes of the baked plant volumes: volume index (bindings 10 to 12), min, size, voxel.

fields.name: textures
fields.desc: Textures the rays test leaves against (view set binding 6), at most max_textures (512).

components.notes: Emplaced by RayScene's constructor, erased by its destructor. add(RayMesh) and add(RayBox) return stable indices (nothing is taken back); texture(view, sampler) returns the index of a texture, -1 past 512. Added to by VegetationPass, ModelPass, PlantVolumes; read by RayScene. Main thread only.

components.name: RayBake
components.summary: A mesh to put alone in the scene of this frame, for the rays that bake a plant volume.

fields.name: origin
fields.desc: Where its instance goes (0, -20000, 0): far under the world.

fields.name: placed
fields.desc: RayScene put it in this frame's top level structure.

components.notes: Emplaced and erased by RayScene. PlantVolumes::prepare writes mesh and origin, RayScene::gatherInstances writes placed, PlantVolumes::update bakes only when placed.

components.name: RayPlantMeshes
components.summary: The traced mesh, volume box and bounds of each species of the vegetation library.

fields.name: mesh
fields.desc: Per species: index in RayMeshes::meshes, -1 while not loaded.

fields.name: box
fields.desc: Per species: index in RayMeshes::boxes, -1 while its volume is not baked.

fields.name: min
fields.desc: Bounds of the most detailed level, low corner.

components.notes: Emplaced by VegetationPass's constructor when RayMeshes exists (ray tracing); mesh, min, max written by VegetationPass::finishJob, box by PlantVolumes::finish; read by RayScene::gatherInstances and PlantVolumes. Never erased (lives with the registry context).

components.name: PlantVolumeSet
components.summary: The baked volume of each species, for the pass that draws far plants from it.

fields.name: species
fields.desc: Per species: index (of its textures in bindings 10 to 12, -1 not baked), min (bounds in plant space), size, voxel (metres a texel).

components.notes: Emplaced and erased by PlantVolumes (ray tracing only); an entry written by PlantVolumes::finish; read by VegetationPass::update and record.

components.name: RayAnimals
components.summary: The animals that cast shadows this frame, skinned by the compute commands of the frame.

fields.name: animals
fields.desc: Per animal: entity, vertices (skinned buffer, four floats a vertex), first_vertex, vertex_count, indices (shadow level, relative to its first vertex), index_count, matrix, color.

components.notes: Emplaced by AnimalPass's constructor with ray tracing, cleared and filled by AnimalPass::update every frame (the nearest casters within the traced range), erased by its destructor. RayScene::updateAnimals builds a structure for each, refits it while it stays listed and lets it go otherwise.

components.name: PlantInRays
components.summary: A plant that is its leaves in the rays (within the plant geometry range of the tiers, with a margin to leave).
components.notes: Added and removed by RayScene::gatherInstances (enters at plant_geometry_range, leaves at 1.15 x it); storage cleared by RayScene's destructor.

components.name: PlantRayTransforms
components.summary: Where the instances of a plant go in the top level structure, worked out once (plants do not move).

fields.name: mesh
fields.desc: Three rows of four of the plant's matrix, for its mesh instance.

fields.name: box
fields.desc: Rows of the box of its species' volume over its bounds.

fields.name: boxed
fields.desc: The RayBox the box rows were made for, -1 none.

components.notes: Emplaced by RayScene::gatherInstances on every Transform + Plant entity without one; box rows recomputed when the species' box changes; storage cleared by RayScene's destructor. A plant that moves keeps its first rows.
